import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.apps.registry import Apps
from django.db import models, connection

repro_apps = Apps()


class User(models.Model):
    email = models.EmailField()
    kind = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=[("ADMIN", "Admin"), ("REGULAR", "Regular")])

    class Meta:
        apps = repro_apps
        app_label = "repro"


class Profile(models.Model):
    full_name = models.CharField(max_length=255)
    user = models.OneToOneField(User, on_delete=models.CASCADE)

    class Meta:
        apps = repro_apps
        app_label = "repro"


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(User)
    se.create_model(Profile)

from django.db.models import Prefetch
from django.test.utils import CaptureQueriesContext

u = User.objects.create(email="test@example.com", kind="ADMIN")
Profile.objects.create(user=u, full_name="Test Tester")

# --- instrumentation ---
from django.db.models.fields import related_descriptors as rd
from django.db.models import query as qmod

orig_fwd = rd.ForwardOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset
orig_rev = rd.ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset
orig_pol = qmod.prefetch_one_level


def fwd(self, instances, queryset=None):
    print(f"  [fwd get_prefetch_queryset] field={self.field.name} n_instances={len(instances)} qs_only={queryset.query.deferred_loading if queryset else None}")
    return orig_fwd(self, instances, queryset)


def rev(self, instances, queryset=None):
    print(f"  [rev get_prefetch_queryset] rel={self.related.get_cache_name()} n_instances={len(instances)}")
    return orig_rev(self, instances, queryset)


def pol(instances, prefetcher, lookup, level):
    out = orig_pol(instances, prefetcher, lookup, level)
    print(f"  [prefetch_one_level] lookup={lookup.prefetch_through} level={level} n={len(instances)} -> {len(out[0])} objs, additional={[l.prefetch_through for l in out[1]]}")
    return out


rd.ForwardOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset = fwd
rd.ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset = rev
qmod.prefetch_one_level = pol
# prefetch_related_objects references prefetch_one_level by module global at call time
import django.db.models.query  # noqa

qs = User.objects.only("email").prefetch_related(
    Prefetch(
        "profile",
        queryset=Profile.objects.prefetch_related(
            Prefetch("user", queryset=User.objects.only("kind"))
        ),
    )
)
print("=== iterating queryset ===")
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
    user = qs.first()
print(f"QUERIES during first(): {len(ctx.captured_queries)}")
for q in ctx.captured_queries:
    print("   ", q["sql"])

p = user.profile
print("profile fields_cache keys:", list(p._state.fields_cache.keys()))
inner = p.user
print("outer user:", id(user), "dict keys:", sorted(user.__dict__), "deferred:", user.get_deferred_fields())
print("inner user:", id(inner), "dict keys:", sorted(inner.__dict__), "deferred:", inner.get_deferred_fields())
print("same object?", inner is user)

print("=== accessing .kind ===")
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx2:
    val = inner.kind
print(f"QUERIES accessing kind: {len(ctx2.captured_queries)}")
for q in ctx2.captured_queries:
    print("   ", q["sql"])
print("kind =", val)

## Findings
- #32511 (deferred fields wrong after nested prefetch back to parent) FIXED in django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py.
- Root cause: ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset and create_reverse_many_to_one_manager unconditionally overwrote the child->parent cache after evaluating the child queryset; when the child queryset had its own nested Prefetch back to the parent, the nested prefetch had already cached the correct (differently-deferred) instance, and the outer loop clobbered it with the parent instance from the outer queryset. Later lookups then saw is_fetched=True and skipped re-fetching, so e.g. .kind raised/wrongly deferred.
- Fix: guard both loops with `if not <field>.is_cached(rel_obj)`. Matches upstream commit f5233dce30 (which only covered the reverse-FK manager); the O2O guard is the additional half needed for the OneToOne variant.
- Verified: standalone repro (O2O + FK variants): 3 queries on iteration, 0 on .profile.user.kind, kind=ADMIN, inner instance has kind loaded/email deferred. Suites green: prefetch_related (105 OK), many_to_one+one_to_one+queries (497 OK), defer+defer_regress+many_to_many+generic_relations+m2m_through (195 OK).
EOF
